身边的科技 · 把想法变成步骤: Everyday technology · Turn ideas into steps
手机能计时，小车能送货，是谁告诉它下一步做什么？程序是一套设备能够执行的指令。先: A phone can time things and a cart can deliver. What tells them what to do next? A program is a set of instructions a device can execute. Give this cart a clear plan, then watch what it actually does.
先取货，再送到 B 点: Pick up first, then deliver to B
本地模拟 · 不连接真实机器人: Local simulation · No real robot connection
桌面送货小车、取货点、收货点，以及根据程序留下的行走轨迹: Tabletop delivery cart, pickup and delivery stations, and the travel trace produced by its program
绿色线是这次已经走过的路。包裹在取货点、小车上或收货点，只会出现在一个地方。: The green line is the route already travelled in this test. The parcel is in just one place: pickup station, cart or delivery station.
在路中间放一个箱子: Put a box on the road
先猜一猜，再逐条试：小车走开以后，还能在 A 点取到包裹吗？: Predict, then test each card: after the cart moves away, can it pick up the parcel at A?
交换前两张卡，再试: Swap the first two cards and retest
改指令会明确开始一次新测试；切换实验和讲解方式会保留当前测试。: Editing instructions explicitly starts a new test; changing experiments or reading depth retains the current test.
箭头指向下一条；打勾表示已经执行。遇到条件卡，先读输入，再加入所选路线的卡片。: The arrow points to the next card; a check marks an executed card. A condition card reads the input, then adds cards for the chosen route.
条件卡里的两份计划: Two plans inside the condition card
如果前面有箱子: If there is a box ahead
一次只执行其中一份，不会把两条路线都走一遍。: Only one plan executes each time; the cart does not follow both routes.
同一个想法，也藏在生活里: The same idea appears in everyday life
轮子、电动机和芯片是硬件。程序属于软件，它规定这些部件什么时候做什么。有程序还需: Wheels, motors and chips are hardware. A program is software: it specifies when these parts do what. A program also needs working hardware and power to make anything actually move.
按计时器的开始键是输入；程序开始计时，到了设定时间让声音响起是输出。这里的输入是: Pressing a timer’s start button is an input. The program starts counting; a sound at the set time is an output. Here, the obstacle reading is an input; cart movement, pickup and unloading are outputs.
会执行，不等于知道你的心愿: Executing steps does not mean knowing your wish
我们想“把货送到”，但还要写出取货、移动和卸货的具体步骤。这个小车不会猜出漏掉的: We want “deliver the parcel”, but still need specific pickup, movement and unloading steps. This cart does not guess omitted steps. A robot is a machine; a program is instructions. Some robots use AI; this example does not.
这幅图省略了什么？: What does this illustration leave out?
这是一个固定指令的小程序解释器。取放、转向和传感器均为教学动作，不是对真实机械手: This is a small interpreter with fixed commands. Pickup, turning and sensing are teaching actions, not simulations of real manipulators or sensors. Each movement card travels exactly one square. Real vehicles must control motors, measure continuously and handle friction, positioning errors and safety.
指令卡表示本页已经定义好、设备能执行的命令；真实编程可以使用图形积木或文字语言。: The cards represent predefined commands this device can execute. Real programming may use graphical blocks or text languages. Many programs handle several tasks and repeatedly check inputs. This page follows one simple flow, rather than showing every kind of program.

看看前面：有箱子吗？: Look ahead: is there a box?

停在取货卡：小车已离开 A 点，包裹还在那里。需要改顺序，而不是只按更快。: Stopped at pickup: the cart has left A, but the parcel is still there. Change the order; running faster will not fix it.
这条指令无法完成。重新检查小车的位置、包裹和指令顺序。: This command cannot be completed. Check cart position, parcel and instruction order.
送到了！同一个包裹现在在 B 点。回看每张卡，你能说出哪一步决定了结果吗？: Delivered! The same parcel is now at B. Look back at the cards: which step determined the result?
先猜下一步会发生什么，再执行第一张卡。现在小车和包裹都在 A 点。: Predict the next action, then execute the first card. The cart and parcel are both at A.
还没执行判断卡：传感器读数尚未读取。: Decision card not executed: sensor input has not been read yet.
判断时读到：有箱子。已经选择旁边的小路。: Reading at decision: box present. The detour was selected.
判断时读到：没有箱子。已经选择直路。: Reading at decision: no box. The straight route was selected.

屏幕保护停住了小车：它早已选好直路，程序没有再读传感器。画面不允许小车与箱子重叠: The screen guard stopped the cart: it had already chosen straight ahead, and the program did not read the sensor again. The illustration refuses an overlap with the box; a real cart without another check could collide. Retest to read the input again.
箱子是环境，传感器的读数是输入；选路规则是程序。它只在“看看前面”这条指令执行时: The box is part of the environment; the sensor reading is an input; the route rule is the program. It reads once, when “look ahead” executes. Add a box later and the screen guard refuses an overlapping move; a real cart without another check could collide.
